review: The complete source requires raypunk primary context, a spacecraft workbench, finned transmitter, remote beacon verification and crew handoff. None is established in this ordinary field-radio scene. Copying only its power-cell replacement would discard its conditions; skip, no alternative admitted.

The source connects an established adult subject to an actual local cuff seam, repair tools and a supported hand. The frozen scene supplies radio/battery work, not cuff repair or an adult age fact. Both hands already carry equipment. Applying it would need a separate action and unsourced owners; skip.

Complete source is an adult checking a map plus outdoor equipment. No adult age is frozen and her hands act on the battery while the map remains a contextual prop. Turning her to map checking changes the action proof rather than adding a useful local detail; skip.

The source confines use traces to reachable contact surfaces, preserving coherent material edges. A1 gives the existing radio a reachable worn handgrip and continuous housing seams. This is an independently justified generic material refinement, without native whole-source adoption. Retain A1 literal: realistic skin and a radio handgrip whose rubbed paint stays on its reachable edges, with continuous housing seams beneath the wear.

The source is a dressing gesture connected with work or departure, and requires an established adult subject and all named elements outside its composition-only effect. No dressing action or adult age is frozen. Adding clothing adjustment would take a working hand from the radio; skip.

The complete source is a transformation-heroine dual-life scene, mending a protective overlayer while checking a work pager, under an explicit atomic-scene prerequisite. That primary context and its pager/garment action are absent. Generic maintenance overlap does not make this source applicable; skip.

This source requires an established adult self-adjusting a wearable material and preserves reference appearance. The radio battery is not wearable material; its actual effects include action, appearance, expression, material, pose and setting. Adult fact and wearable-action owners are absent; skip without narrowing the effects.

This complete profile requires replacement unavailability, localized essential-item wear, active repair, care evidence and a returned-to-use result in one image. Here a replacement battery is visibly available and the shutter is mid-insertion. Unavailability would contradict the present replacement and its return-to-use event is absent; skip.

An unconditioned watch-repair bench can be used as an authored place choice without changing the military role. A3 develops it as a complete photograph. Its specialist precision suggests a different repair trade and adds no readable reason for the larger radio task; A1 keeps the general field bench and improves a relevant contact instead. No native adoption.

This Egyptian judgment profile requires a deceased subject, heart-versus-feather balance, Anubis, Thoth and Ammit/Osiris consequence together. Its multiple actors, objects and afterlife event do not preserve the service-member radio-preparation event. Skip complete source; no isolated balance metaphor adopted.

The microscopy workbench explicitly requires microscopy or sample primary tags and has specimen preparation, calibration and diagnostic light. Neither microscopy nor samples exist in the frozen intent. No generic bench extraction is claimed as adoption; skip.

Rail dispatch requires adult rail uniform, platform/train interface, full door/passenger clearance, authorized signal and safe train-departure consequence. A field-radio battery replacement supplies none of that operational system and no adult fact. Shared radio/departure terms are not equivalent; skip.

The existing source is a generic fictional military-uniform inspection room with component bench, full-length inspection context and limited duty equipment. A2 compares the independently justifiable generic inspection-room setting, without native whole-source adoption or importing full-length duty inspection. A2 makes the uniform rather than the leaving-for-field context the likely story; A1 better joins the battery task to the open departure route. Skip.

A mountain-rescue equipment base is an open setting and A4 keeps the same reference-guided soldier, battery action and dawn work. It adds a rescue-purpose implication, but rescue devices/actions are absent and the radio work remains generic. A1 has clearer military preparation with less unsupported specialist context; skip.

The source explicitly depicts an adult woman operating workshop equipment with appropriate protective gear; every undeclared actor/object/place outside action/pose effects must already exist. No adult age fact or protective-gear system is frozen. Handheld battery replacement does not require an invented workshop machine; skip.

Clockpunk prerequisite, automaton, worn/replacement cam plates and separate service stand are a complete mechanical-world realization. None is established and substituting battery for cam plate would discard the source meaning. Removed-versus-new equipment is already independently in the baseline; skip.

Firefighter profile requires adult structural-fire response role, helmet/coat/trousers/gloves/boots protective system, apparatus interface, hazard-matched check and ready-state confirmation. Its own reject_substitutes excludes military-gear substitution. A military radio scene cannot be its adoption; skip.

Dungeon-stream descent requires wearable cameras, rescue beacons, status lights and role-coded battery cases under its named primary scene. A single replacement battery is not that broadcast/role system, and new device owners lack frozen support. Skip.

The character-role-state atomic source concerns loosening role fastenings after completed equipment repair while preserving personal adjustments and repair traces. It requires that specific primary scene; the baseline is mid-battery preparation with both hands occupied. Skip complete source.

Asymmetric long sleeve versus separate cuff changes an open clothing property, yet its cosplay relation would make unequal sleeves compete with the connected battery action. The frozen face/hair reference adds no costume instruction; complete source lacks native admission and there is no independently needed garment asymmetry. Skip; retain coherent field fatigues.

Raw unpolished realism is already independently expressed by documentary register, restrained grain and scuffed working equipment. A1 only locates existing wear at a reachable handgrip. No additional roughness treatment is useful; source is not credited as a new effect. Skip.

Space-horror source is an excavated structure with exactly three marked wall layers and a survey rod against the nearest layer. All endpoints/count/layers must coexist. This would add a different environment and archaeology event unsupported by the frozen military preparation. Skip complete realization.

The espionage source explicitly has two people close with two distinct visible gaze targets. Frozen subject evidence declares only the service member and the scene has no second existing actor; count is not an opened dimension. Its research graph grants no owner/adoption authority. Skip.

Conceptual photograph is a broad medium option already consistent with the authored fictional photographic scene. It supplies no distinct visible change beyond the developed staged moment; adding the label would not improve A1. Skip without an artificial alternative.

This profile is the full same asymmetric sleeve/separate-cuff relation as source 19 and imposes an exact owner/render gate. It is not requested or selected; no native owner qualification is available. The visual asymmetry would compete with the radio operation, so skip the entire profile.

Split authority-subject composition implies a separate authority and subject partition. No authority actor/owner is frozen and adding one changes undeclared person count. It cannot be borrowed as a generic split-light idea; skip.

The existing duty-model source is an adult fictional service member in a coherent uniform system matched to a duty context. Its effect is subject, which is locked; an equal proposed role is still not mutation permission. No adult fact/native qualification is frozen. The independently authored field fatigues already serve the role. Skip.

Full source is adult face/hair in front-facing casting/digitals presentation with soft frontal daylight and local skin variation. No adult fact or casting purpose is established. Frontal generic readability was considered but the current right-front-quarter view is needed to see the rear rail connection with the face. Skip full source; reference features remain preserved.

Apocalypse infrastructure source requires repair bay linking greenhouse and radio room of a mobile base under its explicit primary scene tag. The shelter has no greenhouse, multi-room infrastructure or apocalypse context. Do not treat radio keyword overlap as complete meaning; skip.

Prone-on-forearms source requires lower anterior torso on support and both forearms contacting it while chest rises. No independently frozen body-part/support owner facts admit it natively. Generic prone reconstruction would relocate the bench-level action and obscure its rear rail interface at creativity 1, offering no local benefit. Skip complete pose.

The towel source requires both hands gripping the same towel edge, continuous torso/pelvis coverage and a separate swimsuit behind it. Existing towel and swimsuit owners are absent; both hands are already engaged in the radio mechanism. Its appearance/pose/material effects cannot be narrowed to hand tension. Skip.

Split-face-light profile requires adult character and all five near-90-degree key, central face boundary, bright/shadow halves and modeled shadow contours. Adult fact is absent. A fully opposed half-face pattern also competes with face comparison and battery visibility under the already motivated dawn/task light. Skip full profile, without calling ordinary side warmth equivalent.

Steepled-fingers source requires both corresponding fingertips touching, palms separated and wrists leading to separate arms. No native hand-owner facts are frozen and its two-hand shape cannot coexist with radio/battery grips. It would replace the operative interaction rather than support it; skip.
